author: Palmer Cox
title: The Brownies: Their Book
edition: PG plain-text transcription (pg32210.txt) of the Appleton-Century-Crofts printing of the Century original-English text, copyright 1887; printing undated. The copyright leaf also records renewal in 1915; that is not a printing date. PublicationYear identifies the copyright-dated original text, supported by these primary leaves and the catalogue’s explicit US-public-domain determination. Verse line breaks and illustration-separated text blocks retained; indentation whitespace omitted. Plain-text emphasis markers retained where present. Electronic illustration markers, illustrations, and front matter excluded. No claim of collation with a different print witness is made.

rights.basis: The selected original-English Century text is identified by its copyright 1887 leaf in the undated Appleton-Century-Crofts printing, which also records the 1915 renewal. The original 1887 text is outside its US publication term as of 2026; the PG catalogue explicitly labels this transcription public domain in the USA. Printing year is not inferred from either copyright date. No illustrations or later front matter are selected.

acquisition.method: Downloaded the Project Gutenberg plain text pg32210.txt (the textUrl file) from the aleph.pglaf.org mirror and converted it with a scratch script: CR line ends removed; every story title line (unindented "THE BROWNIES ...") becomes a heading; the verse between blank lines or [Illustration] markers becomes one stanza per text block, lines kept with their indentation dropped; the plain text's _underscore_ emphasis is kept. Omitted: the Project Gutenberg header, footer and licence, the cover, the bookplate form, the title page and copyright leaf, the contents, every [Illustration] marker, and the three captioned illustrations (the frontispiece note on Brownies, "Brownie.", and the song lettered in the singing-school picture) and the closing "THE END" picture. Kept: all twenty-four stories in order.
